brand.name: WAB Interview-to-Story
brand.scope: Interview audio or notes to evidence-linked multilingual story, platform copy, and visual assets; field scope limited to 《即莞来》 and 《选择东莞》
brand.geography: Dongguan, Guangdong, China; designed for cross-border use

decision: Decide whether the public proposition should lead with transcription, content repurposing, or an evidence-aware system that turns interviews into multilingual text and visual assets for different platforms.

degradation_reasons: Only the organization-authorized editorial patterns of 《即莞来》 and 《选择东莞》 are in public scope.
No raw recording, full transcript, named unpublished case, portrait, private source map, or organization-wide governance material is included.
No privacy-safe before-and-after field package or controlled comparison has been published.
No independent target-language or external-operator review has been published.

evidence_ledger.summary: The public case is authorized to refer only to the editorial patterns of 《即莞来》 and 《选择东莞》.

The person-story route separates source intake, time-coded transcript or cleaned text, evidence indexing, editorial diagnosis, direction approval, canonical story, fact and quotation review, bilingual adaptation, and visual delivery.
The person-story route treats the named person as irreplaceable and prohibits using one person's experience as group evidence.
The place/choice route uses current public and authoritative information as primary evidence, with interview material limited to a bounded case or question.
Target-language text is naturally re-edited from an approved Chinese factual mother text while preserving certainty, agency, quotation status, and time state.
Visual production follows story approval and separates generative imagery from exact text, data, logos, quotations, and rights-controlled assets.
External sending and publication remain human-authorized actions separate from completion of the story package.

The public repository contains the wab-interview-to-story Skill, evidence and route references, a machine-readable schema, a dependency-free validator, negative contract tests, and a fictional sample package.
No privacy-safe before-and-after field package has yet been published for either route.
No independent target-language editor or external organizational operator has published a review of the same package.
No controlled comparison establishes improvements in factual accuracy, correction time, cross-channel consistency, reach, or conversion.
One evidence-linked canonical story can reduce factual and brand drift across language, channel, and visual derivatives compared with transcript-to-post prompting.

position_and_difference.rationale: The distinction from transcription and generic content repurposing is clear, while buyer language and realistic alternatives still need external testing.

audience_and_choice_barrier.rationale: Editorial teams, associations, city brands, founders, and B2B teams are plausible users, but the first paid audience and trigger event are not yet selected.

proof_and_credibility.rationale: The operating method and runnable public contract are strong, but no redacted field transformation or independent review is yet public.

experience_and_consistency.rationale: One canonical story and explicit platform contracts create a consistent design, while live target-channel response remains untested.

knowledge_and_workflow.rationale: Evidence, route, language, channel, visual, rights, approval, and publication states are explicit and machine-checkable.

commercial_signal_and_learning.rationale: The workflow addresses a credible recurring problem, but pricing, adoption, retention, and outcome evidence are absent.

primary_bottleneck.statement: The proposition is clear and the Skill is inspectable, but the public evidence does not yet show a privacy-safe field transformation or independent review.
primary_bottleneck.why_first: Leading with reach, speed, or quality claims before publishing a reproducible source-to-output comparison would turn an evidence-aware product into another unsupported AI claim.

differentiation_hypothesis.statement: Unlike transcription and content-repurposing tools, WAB Interview-to-Story establishes one evidence-linked canonical story before deriving multilingual platform copy and visual assets, using different evidence rules for person-led and place/choice stories.

true.rationale: The two field routes and public Skill contract implement the stated sequence and boundaries.

relevant.rationale: Fragmented interview production is a plausible organizational problem, but prospective-user interviews have not yet validated priority or willingness to adopt.

ownable.rationale: The combination is distinctive, but no structured comparison with transcription, repurposing, agency, and manual workflows has been published.

deliverable.rationale: The Skill, schema, validator, contract tests, and fictional package are executable public artifacts.

evidence_needed: One redacted or consented field demonstration for each route
A prompt-only baseline using the same sources, model, channels, and time budget
Measures for unsupported claims, quotation drift, traceability, correction effort, cross-channel contradictions, and visual rework
An external organizational operator test and alternative comparison

next_30_days.priority: Publish a privacy-safe, reproducible transformation package before making productivity or audience claims.
actions: Freeze the product name, first buyer, trigger event, and exact two-route public claim.
Complete one fictional end-to-end package and one redacted demonstration for each approved route.
Run a prompt-only comparison using identical sources, model, channels, and time budget.
Record unsupported claims, quote drift, human corrections, cross-channel contradictions, production time, and visual rework.
Invite an English editor and an external organizational operator to review the package and limitations.
human_decisions: Zhiying Zhong approves the public product positioning and bounded field claim.
The organization approves every redaction and use of a series name, article fragment, quotation, portrait, logo, or visual asset.
The interviewee or authorized rights holder approves applicable text, quotation, portrait, and platform uses.
A language reviewer approves target-language meaning before a derivative is marked approved.
A named account owner authorizes the exact publication action.
do_not_automate: Do not infer quotations, facts, identities, current policy, or publication rights.
Do not force a person story into city promotion or use one person as group evidence.
Do not let an interview replace current authoritative sources in a place/choice story.
Do not let an English adaptation become more certain or promotional than the approved Chinese story.
Do not fabricate a person, place, event, logo, or policy fact inside a visual.
Do not publish from a completed package without explicit account-level authorization.
next_30_days.advance_condition: Advance when one public-safe package for each route passes source traceability, rights, language, visual, and external-operator review and the organization approves publication.

limitations: The field case is organization-authorized and sponsor-led, not independent customer validation.
Only the two approved editorial patterns are public; the organization-wide operating system is out of scope.
No raw interview, named unpublished case, private source map, or internal task inventory is disclosed.
No controlled comparison establishes business, audience, quality, or efficiency effects.
Installing the open Skill does not create project-specific editorial rules, source systems, brand assets, permissions, account governance, or legal clearance.
